Hi Dr. Shah,

I audited Solex Energy's paid funnel this morning (14 Sep 2026). Congratulations on FY26 - 144.3% revenue growth to Rs.1,618 crore, PAT up 132.7%, and a Rs.4,000 crore order book is the strongest set of numbers I have seen in this sector this year.

Which is why these three findings are worth ten minutes of your time.

1. solexenergy.com does not resolve. The connection fails at the SSL handshake on both the bare host and www. Your live site is solex.in. Every older creative, backlink, directory listing and QR code carrying the .com address is landing on an error - and the Google Ads Transparency record for your brand is built on that dead domain.

2. Your homepage stat band reads: 0+ Years of Experience, 14 Successful Projects, M+ 0 Modules Shipped, GW 0 PV Modules Manufacturing Capacity. Three of four counters are stuck at zero, the unit labels have detached from the values, and the only number that renders - 14 - is sitting against Successful Projects when you have publicly executed 200+.

3. Your best asset is invisible. A C&I buyer signing a 30-year linear performance warranty is silently asking one question: will this manufacturer still exist in 2056? Audited, exchange-filed, 144% growth answers that better than any creative could. It is on your investor page and nowhere in your marketing.

One more, gently: the Instagram feed embedded on your homepage currently leads with 80s-nostalgia reels and an office prank. Your buyers are procurement heads.

You have 24.6% efficiency modules, a 12-year product warranty, ALMM certification and a Rs.4,000 crore book. The funnel is not carrying any of it.

15 minutes?

Hi - Smart Pursuit here, we do performance marketing only for solar brands.

Ninety seconds on Solex.

First thing I did was type solexenergy.com. Nothing. Dead at the SSL handshake. Your actual site is solex dot in. So every old ad, backlink and listing pointing at the dot com is landing on an error page.

Then I opened solex.in. Your stat band says zero plus years of experience, fourteen successful projects, M plus zero modules shipped, GW zero manufacturing capacity. Three counters stuck at zero, and the fourteen is sitting against the wrong label - you've done two hundred plus EPC projects.

Meanwhile the actual business did sixteen hundred and eighteen crore in FY26, up a hundred and forty-four percent, with a four thousand crore order book. None of that is in the funnel.

And you're running about thirty-three Meta ads with no LinkedIn layer at all - selling to procurement heads via a feed whose latest posts are eighties nostalgia memes and a birthday tribute.

The fix is short: restore the domain, fix the counters, put an RFQ form on the Tapi pages, and move the B2B half of the budget to ABM. I've got it on one page. Want it?
Re: A 30-year warranty is a promise about 2056. Your site says you have 0 years of experience.

Hi Dr. Shah,

One thought, on the thing that actually decides C&I solar deals.

When a facility head specifies Tapi RC at 24.6% efficiency with a 12-year product and 30-year linear performance warranty, they are accepting a promise that runs to 2056. The unspoken question in that room is never about the module. It is: will this company still be here to honour it?

Solex has the best possible answer. FY26 revenue Rs.1,618 crore, up 144.3%. Q4 up 247.6%. PAT up 132.7% to Rs.98.3 crore. Order book above Rs.4,000 crore. Net debt-to-equity 0.57:1. Operating cash flow Rs.200.7 crore. ALMM certified. NSE listed. FY27 guidance of Rs.2,600 crore.

Audited. Exchange-filed. Unarguable.

And the first thing a visitor to your website reads is '0+ Years of Experience' and '0 GW PV Modules Manufacturing Capacity', because the counters never fire.

That is the whole pitch, really. You do not need new messaging. You need the site to stop contradicting the balance sheet, a quote path on the product pages, and the B2B budget moved off broad Meta onto LinkedIn ABM where the specifiers actually are.

We work with solar brands only. 15 minutes this week?
